correctness.rationale: Regenerative covariance identities Var X_t=2Dt³/3, Cov(X_t,V_t)=Dt², Var V_t=2Dt give V|X=x,T=t~N(3x/(2t),Dt/2) and an exact posterior age density t^(−3/2) exp(−rt−3x²/(4Dt³)). Scaling t=τ_x z gives coercive saddle z+1/(3z³), minimum 4/3 at z=1, second derivative 4. Joint Gaussian exponent adds (u−z^(−1))²/z, proving contraction LDP and nonoutward optimum (z,u)=(√2,0) with rate 4(√2−1)/3. Independent Gaussian decomposition yields age/velocity covariance [[1/4,−σ/4],[−σ/4,3/4]], correlation −σ/√3. Moment claims require the stated Laplace tail bounds, not finite quadrature; boundary fixed D,r>0, x≠0.

value.rationale: PASS: A sharp nonoutward-velocity rare-event exponent and full conditional large-deviation law of extreme stationary excursions are meaningful path-observable refinements of a natural randomly accelerated reset model. They distinguish typical outward velocities from exponentially rare wrong-direction snapshots and from crossing-weighted observables.

limitations: The full exact renewal mixture allows derivation of these consequences by standard methods; an unindexed earlier explicit conditional formula could cover them.
The universal correlation magnitude is separately established for a closely related sheared reset model and is not itself an original invariant.
